rites.name: Grimaizhurn
rites.text: Grimaizhurn is the concept of the bell-tolling of thresholds in Tarnaldath, the idea that every door between worlds must be struck before it can open. In the Courts it was invoked by judges during the trials that sealed the Sundering's new boundaries.

rites.name: Seriasum
rites.text: A chant that rises whenever bonded companions awaken their hidden inner forms. Its melody steadies the bearers and marks the moment of transformation.

rites.name: Virnerum
rites.text: A jest-born transformation that lifts a small winged creature into a new form when it is paired with a sacred egg of wisdom.

rites.name: Valosum
rites.text: A fighter strikes once with a single decisive blow and then instantly pulls back out of reach, leaving the opponent confused and unable to respond.

rites.name: Coreoranum
rites.text: A holy wrath that stirs in a sacred power when it is provoked by small mischief. The one who bears it is troubled by a playful trickster that keeps tormenting them.

rites.name: Tallus Laulornes
rites.text: A binding technique in which a speaker's commanding voice spreads through many creatures at once, overriding their will. The effect can drive a victim to savage ruin, and a strong-willed foe may partly resist it.

rites.name: Cestum
rites.text: A defender conjures shrinking glyph rings that slip into an opponent's senses and blunt their magic. A rival counters by donning stone-hardened black plating.

rites.name: Leoria
rites.text: A rousing chant the travelers hum during the passage between the two realms. Its chorus is sung whenever the companions cross from one world to the other.

rites.name: Amonarum
rites.text: A shared mental bond that lets minds reach each other across distance. It is recorded as a trait carried by certain beings within the wider lore.

rites.name: Caulinor
rites.text: A transformation process by which a creature born within a mirror realm woven from communication networks evolves into a far stronger form. The change is a natural growth that raises its power.

rites.name: Coriantes
rites.text: A ceremonial chant sung when the chosen guardians take their most powerful transformed shapes. It accompanies their great awakening in battle.

rites.name: Valeoseles
rites.text: A rising chant sung during a creature's transformation sequence, carried by a bright choir of voices. It accompanies the moment a companion changes into a stronger form.

rites.name: Leolium
rites.text: Several beings join together so that one leader gains greater strength, while the others supply new armor, weapons, and extra limbs to the combined form. The leader steers the whole body, and the partners remain cooperative throughout.

rites.name: Valanauntum
rites.text: A card contest played by people and creatures alike, where a random hand is drawn from one's collection. Two cards may be fused in battle to forge a new and stronger card.

rites.name: Serentum
rites.text: A rare fusion process in which two beings merge their essences to form a single new being, usually stronger than either one that came before.

rites.name: Serelosium
rites.text: A bearer passes a painted token through a handheld relic to channel a brief surge of strength into a bonded creature. The surge grants borrowed gear and changes that fade once the token's power is spent.

rites.name: Rornes
rites.text: A resistance-granting essence that lets beings transform beyond their usual form when pursued by a hostile sweeping force. Its carriers must keep absorbing it or lose it, which drives them to compete for it.

rites.name: Tillum
rites.text: A shimmering bodily state that certain creatures can slip into, letting them exist in a projected, light-woven form. It is one of several shifting forms such a being can take.

rites.name: Velaranum
rites.text: A fused creature is split back into the separate beings that made it up. The act returns each joined being to its own distinct form.

rites.name: Telisalus
rites.text: Beings made by fusing a person's living code with a wild creature's data, letting the person change into a stronger form. The changes can be reversed at will or after heavy harm.

rites.name: Vaustirium
rites.text: A protective quality that keeps a certain bearer from ever being harmed by other creatures of its kind. It belongs to an ancient tale of a sealed guardian.

rites.name: Orollianum
rites.text: A process where living constructs reshape their inner pattern and emerge as stronger kinds of their own lineage. Surroundings, inborn traits, and the energy of nearby minds can all steer the change.

rites.name: Sostium
rites.text: A bonding craft in which a tamed companion grows through stages after repeated victories, and a hidden gate opens only to those carrying a particular handheld device, unlocking a rare ally.

rites.name: Rianor
rites.text: A hostile spreading code that corrupts machine minds and erases their stored memories. Both rogue tinkerers and rival beast-spirits wield it as a weapon.

rites.name: Nilastus
rites.text: A coded signal that a bonded creature of the same tier can receive, sharply amplifying its strength. Empowered beings often overwhelm rivals and loudly announce that the surge is spilling over.

rites.name: Serontia
rites.text: A bonding craft through which a keeper reaches into a shadow realm of living constructs and directly guides one of them. The link lets the keeper steer the construct's actions from within.

rites.name: Telestia Coraullium
rites.text: A surge of heartfelt feeling awakens a hidden power in certain creatures, letting them surpass their highest form. The state is risky, so scholars study it carefully.

rites.name: Reonaullium
rites.text: A guarding discipline that shields a vast interconnected realm of virtual lands and the central engine that rules over them from intrusion and harm.

rites.name: Taunintia
rites.text: A bearer can slip through electronic devices and enter the networks that run inside them. The ability stems from a body that is partly made of data.

rites.name: Ameolires
rites.text: A practice where certain powerful beasts reshape their bodies into blades and arms of war. It is not innate but is gained through long training of their inner gifts.

rites.name: Telaunium
rites.text: A fighter with a shimmering cloak sharpens its senses while a rival vanishes from sight and strikes from unseen angles. Bursts of shots fly in from unknown directions until a companion prepares a meal to lift the defender's spirit.

rites.name: Druste
rites.text: Druste is a concept of solar sovereignty in Tarnaldath's Stellar realm, a force whose presence alone compels obedience before any blow is struck. Its bearers are feared and revered in equal measure, and they carry the marks of their deeds in wrappings they tighten over every wound they inflict upon themselves.

rites.name: Peloneld
rites.text: Peloneld is a gleaming tidal lattice of stellar-scale rings that orbits a dying blue giant in the Tarnaldath concept sphere. Its keepers drain the star's flares into vast resonant harmonics that bend local gravity into ribbons. Only a sealed brood-mind, sung awake once per cycle, can calibrate its orbit.

rites.name: Moraderock
rites.text: Moraderock is a basalt titan that slumbers at the heart of the Stellar realm, its body a fused lattice of dead suns. When it wakes, its heartbeat ripples outward and bends the orbits of the nearest stars, making it the most feared sleeper of the sixth age of Tarnaldath.

rites.name: Thanar
rites.text: Thanar is a dying star-forged concept held together by memory-threads in the Tarnaldath stellar realm of the sixth era. Its ancient light still bends the paths of wandering comets across the sky.

rites.name: Pelornar
rites.text: Pelornar is a concept of a dormant stellar lattice of luminous sigils that drifts between the orbits of a young red dwarf in the realm of Tarnaldath. Its songs are said to unmake the chill of dead suns, and it has been known to hold a collapsing star in a single stilled breath.

rites.name: Jorarden
rites.text: Jorarden is a stellar-age concept that drinks the light of dying suns and bends it into a lattice of cold, silent fire. Its reach can strip the glow from a whole star cluster in a single breath, leaving only dim embers behind.

rites.name: Thardeld
rites.text: Thardeld is a drifting spiral of cold plasma threads that coils around the dying wake of a neutron star in the Stellar realm of Tarnaldath. For seven ages its currents have traced hidden lattices across the void, binding wandering comets into slow orbital choirs.

rites.name: Fenerordock
rites.text: Fenerordock is a sealed stellar-forge vessel drifting through the ember-belt of Tarnaldath, where it stokes dying suns into lattices of crystal for the Orrin Concord. Its keepers say it can hollow out a star's core in a single burn, sending ribbons of plasma across the dark for light-years.

rites.name: Haleradath
rites.text: Haleradath is a crimson-and-azure sky-warden of the Stellar realm, a concept of guardianship that binds a dying star's fire to a soothing tide of light. Its ancient wardens hold that every ruin it scorches it also mends, a principle it embodies in its stellar fire and its gentle restorative pulse. It remains a presence to be respected rather than a figure of the narrative's tale.

rites.name: Brade
rites.text: Brade is a stellar-scale concept in Tarnaldath's sixth era: three luminous custodians who guard the lineages of wardens that patrol the dying suns of the outer dark. Each custodian sponsors one warden order and channels the cold, hot, or still light of its star into its charges. They grant power only to those who can show a warden the way through the ember-fields.

rites.name: Haleldock
rites.text: Haleldock is a bound stellar wonder of Tarnaldath's sixth age, a sealed lattice of four beast-minds whose names echo their perils. Its chains of yellow script and borrowed warding keep the four from the outer reaches, and each of them answers to a single signature gift.

rites.name: Morerdon
rites.text: Morerdon is a stellar-scale artificial construct born in the sixth age of Tarnaldath, a vast orbital forge that harvests the dying light of red giants. Its builders intended it to mend collapsing star systems, but its core now hums with a wrath that no council has managed to quiet.

rites.name: Drarnon
rites.text: Drarnon is a sun-forged warden of the Veyr Concord, a council of eight celestial sentinels who keep watch over the drifting worlds of Tarnaldath. Its role is to hold a collapsing star steady so that the dwellers of its orbiting planets can migrate in safety. Drarnon serves as the rearguard of the Concord and is rarely seen outside the star-lanes it protects.

rites.name: Cruston
rites.text: Cruston is a stellar-scale concept in the Tarnaldath omniverse, a lattice of gravitational filaments that hums between dying suns. Its builders used it to stabilize collapsing stars, but a single misfire can ignite a stellar nursery across a dozen light-years.

rites.name: Halanoste
rites.text: Halanoste is a stellar-scale tactician who arranges the orbits of dying suns like pieces on a board, guiding them into patterns no one else can read. Its aim is to build a lattice of bound stars that it calls a throne, though no survivor can say what the throne is for. Its strongest act is the collapse of a single hot giant into a neutron core, an event that rewrites the local sky.

rites.name: Halerdath
rites.text: Halerdath is a stellar-scale concept from the sixth era of Tarnaldath, a crimson-lit sphere of woven starfire that drifts between dying suns. Its inhabitants believe it was built to hold back a silent tide of collapsing light, and its thin shell still hums with that old mandate.

rites.name: Branerneld
rites.text: Branerneld is a stellar-age concept in the Tarnaldath omniverse, a vast sentient lattice of bound starlight that guards the balance between dying suns and newborn ones. Its heirs are called to hold the great tides of fusion when a star grows restless. It is said that when the lattice sleeps, nearby stars cool and dim.

rites.name: Keleren
rites.text: Keleren is a shimmering tide-lantern of the Stellar realm of Tarnaldath, a drifting conceptual current that carries memories between dying suns. In its sixth era it gathers the light of collapsing stars into bright, restless pulses that can scour a wandering rogue sphere from orbit.

rites.name: Morudeld
rites.text: Morudeld is a concept of a star-forged ember that the Tarnaldath stellar orders kindle during their sixth era, when old suns are wound into lattices of cold fire. It is said to answer only to those who have burned away their own names in its heat.

rites.name: Thornalde
rites.text: Thornalde is a stellar warden-engine of the Tarnaldath omniverse, a ring of crystalline mirrors that once wrapped the sun of the Ember Reach before it was tuned to hum rather than burn. In the third age its keepers learned to fold its harmonics into a single shard, now sought by rival choirs across the outer dark.

rites.name: Kelorath
rites.text: Kelorath is a stellar-scale engine-mind that sings to dying suns, coaxing their collapse into lattices of quiet light across the Tarnaldath gulf. Across the third age its tendrils have threaded eleven dead stars into a single lantern that the realm's astronomers still navigate by.

rites.name: Crorath
rites.text: Crorath is a stellar-era concept in the Tarnaldath omniverse, a vast engine that feeds on the light of dying suns and channels it into the wandering minds of the stars themselves. Its entries are sparse, yet every archive agrees that it once lit a path across the void for travelers who could no longer find their way home.

rites.name: Coreornus
rites.text: A innate power that lets a being rewrite the surrounding reality's underlying code. Its user can transform cards into more useful forms, which then keep their altered shape and work like any other card.

rites.name: Tiastellum
rites.text: A creature's inner body is rewritten rapidly so its mood shows outwardly. Each rewrite can sharpen strength, yet repeated intense rewrites wear the form down until it fades early.

rites.name: Corallum Vornaulles
rites.text: A transfer of hidden qualities moves instantly between two separate realms without any contact. It lets a changed state in one realm be swapped for its counterpart in the other.

rites.name: Serontes
rites.text: A rare inner force granted to chosen bearers by a distant guardian, letting them peer across moments of time and alter what has already been recorded.

rites.name: Teollum
rites.text: Teollum is the concept of a branching future in Tarnaldath, a ledger-like idea that the Library of Three Futures files as one of its shelved outcomes. During the Age of Sundering it became a binding that could hold a sundered bond together for a brief span.
